classes.name: TNF inhibitors
classes.description: Adalimumab and biosimilars (Humira, Hadlima, Hyrimoz, Cyltezo, Yusimry, Simlandi, Amjevita, unbranded adalimumab-adaz/-fkjp/-aacf), etanercept (Enbrel, Erelzi, Eticovo), certolizumab (Cimzia), golimumab (Simponi). Infliximab is infusion/medical benefit.

classes.name: IL-17 and IL-23 inhibitors

criteria: Ankylosing spondylitis (age 18+): active AS AND prior therapy, contraindication, or intolerance with an NSAID (e.g., ibuprofen, meloxicam, naproxen).
Psoriatic arthritis (age 18+): diagnosis of active psoriatic arthritis.
Rheumatoid arthritis (age 18+): moderately to severely active RA AND prior therapy or intolerance to a single DMARD, or contraindication to all DMARDs.
Polyarticular JIA (age 2+): moderately to severely active pJIA AND prior therapy, contraindication, or intolerance with a DMARD (e.g., methotrexate, cyclosporine, leflunomide).
Plaque psoriasis (age 18+): moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis AND prior oral systemic therapy or intolerance, or contraindication to all conventional oral systemics.
Behcet's oral ulcers (age 18+): Behcet's disease AND prior treatment, contraindication, or intolerance with 2 of: topical corticosteroid, azathioprine, colchicine, cyclosporine.
UC (age 5+), Crohn's (age 6+), or HS (age 12+): moderate to severe activity. Uveitis (age 2+): prior intravitreal or systemic steroid, antimetabolite, or calcineurin inhibitor.

records.verificationNote: Otulfi 45 mg/0.5 mL syringe read on page 72: Tier 3 (Preferred Brand), PA and QL 1.5 per 84 days. No IL-17 or IL-23 agent in this class is listed without PA. Otulfi is a ustekinumab biosimilar, the lowest tier in the class. The pick is a judgment call: the 45 mg strength is the lowest-tier listed product. Brodalumab (Siliq), bimekizumab (Bimzelx), ixekizumab (Taltz), tildrakizumab (Ilumya) and the other ustekinumab biosimilars (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Imuldosa, Steqeyma) are not listed. Omlyclo (omalizumab) appears on page 72 but is outside this class. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-read by x-coordinate on v17 pages 70-74. Adjudicated: Otulfi and Yesintek are both Tier 3 (Preferred Brand) with PA and QL 1.5 per 84 days for the 45 mg dose, so Otulfi is one of two equal picks, not the sole preferred product; Stelara and unbranded ustekinumab are Tier 5. Ustekinumab blocks IL-12/23 (the class definition includes it); Cosentyx, Tremfya and Skyrizi, the IL-17 and IL-23 agents, are all Tier 5 with PA, so the ustekinumab biosimilar is the lowest-barrier product.] [Reused: same national Humana Premier Rx PDP formulary (exported 2026-11-02)]
